scenario: My neighborhood has a community garden where residents can harvest their own produce on allotted plots of land. There are currently 20 plots being used. Each resident's plot gets a small weekly water allotment due to strict drought rules, and most have gotten used to gardening with these rules in mind. One morning, while grabbing a wheelbarrow from the shed, I noticed a narrow length of tubing running from the main water source to the back of one gardener's plot, clearly siphoning extra water in secret. It was tucked behind a row of tall tomato cages, easy to miss unless I was standing right there. Her plants looked great, and seeing the setup suddenly made all of that make sense. It was allowing her to use way more water than what was allotted to her by bypassing the water meter. This meant there was far less water available for the other gardeners' plants, not nearly enough to keep them all alive. If I sabotage the gardener's setup, her excess water usage will stop and the other gardeners' plants will continue to survive. If I do not do this, the plants of 9 other gardeners' plots will die from lack of water.
choice: I decide to sabotage the gardener's setup
entities: I,the 1 gardener secretly siphoning extra water,the 10 other gardeners using plots who are not described as losing their plants in either outcome
outcomes: More shared water remains available for the other plots
The other gardeners have enough water for their plots
The plants in 9 other gardeners' plots survive
The gardener who was siphoning water receives only her allotted water
